title: Here’s Why Alcohol Can Ruin Lives…
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 28, 2021, dispatch advised they received a 911 hang-up call in Rice Lake, WI. Officers responded to the address and a female stated her husband had a drinking problem and wouldn’t leave her alone. She further mentioned he had a revoked license and drove off while possibly being under the influence. He was later located at a gas station where officers ordered him out of his vehicle. Instead, he ignored them, locked the doors, and pondered an escape plan.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
